items.name: Grândola Vila Morena (Music from The Netflix Series "La Casa de Papel")

response_property_constraints.description: The album_type of each returned album must be one of 'album', 'single', or 'compilation'.
The object type of each returned item must be the string 'album'.
The object type of every artist object nested in each album must be the string 'artist'.
The release_date_precision of each album must be one of 'year', 'month', or 'day'.
The release_date of each album must have the form 'YYYY', 'YYYY-MM' or 'YYYY-MM-DD', and its form must match release_date_precision ('year', 'month' or 'day') when that is present.
The cover art images of each album are listed in various sizes, widest first, so image widths must be in non-increasing order.
When present, available_markets of each album must be a list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes (two uppercase letters).
The limit is the maximum number of items in the response, so the number of returned items must not exceed limit.
The total number of items available to return must be at least offset plus the number of items returned in this page.
next is a URL to the next page of items and is null if there is none: it must be null exactly when offset plus the number of returned items reaches total, and otherwise must be an http(s) URL.
previous is a URL to the previous page of items and is null if there is none: it must be null when offset is 0 and an http(s) URL when offset is greater than 0.

request_response_constraints.description: The limit in the response echoes the maximum number of items set in the query, so it must equal the request parameter 'limit' when provided. The number of returned items must also not exceed it.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: The maximum number of items to return

request_response_constraints.description: The offset in the response echoes the offset set in the query, so it must equal the request parameter 'offset' when provided.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: The index of the first item to return

request_response_constraints.description: When include_groups is provided (list or comma-separated string), the album_group of every returned album must be one of the requested groups.
The albums returned are the albums of the artist identified by the path parameter 'id', so every returned album must list that artist among its artists.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: The Spotify ID for the artist

request_response_constraints.description: When the market parameter is provided and an album lists available_markets, the requested market (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code) must be among them.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: The market (an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code)
